mistake_reason: The orchestrator incorrectly interpreted the tool outputs from WebSurfer. Despite the browser tool explicitly listing and highlighting "Format Document" in the context menu and extracting nearby text stating "Click Format Document to clean up spacing and remove extra lines," the orchestrator misread these outputs and concluded the clicked command was "Trim Trailing Whitespace." This is a classic FM-4.2 (Tool Output Misinterpretation): deriving an unsound conclusion from clear and unambiguous tool output, and effectively treating contradictory documentation (which states trimming trailing whitespace does not remove blank lines) as supporting evidence.
